node.statement: Fix n>=1 and X in M_n(B). For each diagonal term set U_t=I_n tensor W_t, X_t=X U_t^dagger, Y_t=U_t, and Z_t=tilde-Delta_n(X_t) tilde-Delta_n(Y_t). Entrywise amplification of the defining finite sum gives Delta_prime_n(X)=sum_t q_t Phi_n(Z_t). Since U_t is unitary, ||X_t||=||X||, ||Y_t||=1, and X_t Y_t=X.
